messages.subject: Project Marlin - SA v3 (our response)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Following the call, here's v3. We've met you in the middle on the thresholds - de minimis to £12,500 and basket to £60,000 - and the Company has agreed to bring the Company warranty cap down to £1.5m (founders pushed on this). 'All reasonable endeavours' accepted. I think this is close to final on liability.

Subscription Agreement v3 redline attached.

Sarah

--
